pmid:43034279.reason: Exploratory cfDNA fragment-end motif study; motif features correlated with estimated ctDNA abundance in 50 EGFR-mutant NSCLC patients (rho 0.73); methodological, not yet clinically validated.

pmid:43033550.reason: Narrative review of radiolabelled molecular probes and theranostics in lung cancer; no new clinical data.

pmid:43032665.reason: Narrative review of nanomedicine delivery systems for lung cancer drug resistance; largely preclinical.

pmid:43032549.reason: Narrative review of gut microbiota metabolites and immunotherapy in NSCLC; authors note evidence is from small studies and animal models.

pmid:43034056.reason: Swedish (Linköping) study on how updated cardiopulmonary exercise testing guidelines affect operability assessment for lung cancer surgery; no abstract available, so the findings are unknown.

pmid:43033142.reason: Narrative review of anaesthetic management and oncological outcome in lung cancer surgery; it concludes current evidence does not support choosing an agent for oncological benefit.

pmid:43031952.reason: Meta-analysis of 10 non-randomised, mostly retrospective studies: ICI-based subsequent therapy after first-line chemoimmunotherapy in ES-SCLC associated with longer OS (HR 0.62, 95% CI 0.51-0.74); high risk of selection bias.

pmid:43033040.reason: Umbrella review of 76 meta-analyses of prognostic factors in ICI-treated NSCLC; only 7 of 112 associations reached Class I evidence (e.g., ALI, tissue TMB, thyroid dysfunction).

pmid:43032124.reason: Single-centre retrospective model (n=134) predicting locoregional recurrence after cCRT in driver-negative stage III NSCLC; no external validation.

pmid:43034147.reason: Small retrospective real-world study (n=94) of second-line regimens after first-line chemoimmunotherapy in ES-SCLC; anti-angiogenic-containing therapy associated with worse OS.

pmid:43033602.reason: Single-centre retrospective cohort of resected typical carcinoids (n=97, 6 recurrences); nodal positivity associated with recurrence; very few events.

pmid:43032292.reason: Multicentre retrospective cohort (n=307) of thoracic RT timing in ES-SCLC after first-line therapy: no OS difference between consolidative and delayed TRT, longer PFS-DR with consolidative TRT (HR 0.30), more grade 2 pneumonitis.

pmid:43032111.reason: Case report of SCLC after suspected methotrexate-associated lymphoproliferative disorder.

pmid:43032902.reason: Journal news report that adjuvant nivolumab did not improve disease-free survival in resected NSCLC, a negative adjuvant immunotherapy result; no abstract, so trial name, size and HR are not given in the item.

pmid:43034549.reason: Modelling study of PM2.5-attributable mortality in China under the tightened air quality standard; lung cancer is one of several outcomes, not a screening or never-smoker study.

pmid:43032239.reason: Technical evaluation of a size-based microfluidic CTC isolation platform with spike-ins and a few patient samples; analytical only.

pmid:43033214.reason: Dosimetric planning comparison (n=30, mixed tumours) of optimiser effects on cardiac substructure dose; no clinical outcomes.

pmid:43034640.reason: Single-centre UK retrospective series (n=24) of nivolumab+ipilimumab in mesothelioma: mPFS 4.5 mo, mOS 9.5 mo, grade >=3 irAEs 25%, 83% hospitalised; very small.

pmid:43034220.reason: Retrospective PSM study (n=130; 44 matched pairs) of cytoreductive surgery with vs without hyperthermic intrathoracic chemotherapy for pleural-disseminated thymic epithelial tumours: 3-yr PFS 87.3% vs 48.6% (HR 0.28).

pmid:43032416.reason: Historical occupational exposure reconstruction at a Colombian asbestos-cement plant; no clinical data.
